# 冰凍附魔

[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1327308441324097681?label=discord&color=blue&logo=discord)](https://discord.gg/5UdcDa5xNC)
[![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/freezing-enchantment?label=modrinth&logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/freezing-enchantment)
[![授權許可](https://img.shields.io/github/license/lullaby6/data-packs)](https://github.com/lullaby6/data-packs/blob/main/LICENSE)

適用於劍的`冰凍`附魔，能對攻擊目標施加緩速效果。

此附魔最高可達2級，每提升1級將延長效果持續時間。

可透過附魔台、戰利品箱或與村民交易獲得此附魔。

## ⌨️ 指令

給予：

```mcfunction
/loot give @s loot freezing_enchantment:<等級>
```

附魔：

```mcfunction
/enchant @s freezing_enchantment:freezing <等級>
```

## 🪪 授權許可

[AGPL-3.0-or-later](https://github.com/lullaby6/data-packs/blob/main/LICENSE)
